name: hearth
description: Warm, photo-led theme for home builders and trades: split heroes, full-bleed photo bands, a step-by-step process list and a terracotta footer.

color_mode.title: Colour mode
color_mode.description: What a first-time visitor sees: auto follows the visitor's system. Visitors can still switch with the header toggle.

header_cta_label.title: Header button label
header_cta_label.description: The outlined button at the right of the header. Empty hides it.

header_cta_url.title: Header button address
header_cta_url.description: Where the header and footer buttons lead.

footer_headline.title: Footer headline
footer_headline.description: The large line in the terracotta footer band.
footer_headline.default: Every project starts with a conversation.

footer_lead.title: Footer text
footer_lead.description: The short line under the footer headline.
footer_lead.default: Tell us about your block and what you want to build.

footer_grain.title: Footer grain
footer_grain.description: A fine film grain over the footer band.

hero_house_mark.title: House outline on the hero
hero_house_mark.description: A thin house outline drawn across the split hero on wide screens.

footer_email.title: Footer email
footer_email.description: An email address shown next to the phone number in the footer. Empty hides it.
